title: Dashboard + Rollout: visual consistency pass, edge-state redlines, and dev handoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Conduct a focused visual-consistency pass and developer handoff for the Dashboard rollouts and cost tiles. Scope includes resolving edge-state UI (empty states, throttled requests, fallback model variants), finalizing spacing and density for compact mode, applying accessible color contrast for cost sparklines, and creating a short implementation spec for rollout state transitions. Deliverables: updated Figma screens (desktop + compact), redlines layer, motion specs for row expand/collapse, and a succinct dev handoff doc with component tokens and QA checklist.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes added. Agreed scope: rollout states, cost tiles, compact density, and accessibility pass. Owner: Marco Liu for handoff. Blockers: final realtime data behavior from ENG-7832.

2026-02-22 - Marco Liu: Iteration 1 uploaded to Figma (frames: dashboard-overview-v4, rollout-states-v2). Focused on aligning chip/tile spacing to new token set. Left questions for PM about which rollout states require explicit error messages vs. subtle badges.
2026-02-25 - Sara Thompson (PM): Decision: show explicit banners for 'unavailable capacity' and use passive badges for 'degraded'. Added note to parent PM-4120 to update copy.

2026-03-01 - Visual review with Design Lead (Diego Rivera): Requested tighter baseline grid alignment and increase contrast of cost sparklines for AA compliance. Added redline layer and created microinteraction spec for 'rollout status hover' and 'compact tile expand'.

2026-03-04 - Eng review (ENG-7832 owner, Priya Nair): Confirmed that KV cache fallback state will surface a 503-coded response; agreed to map this to 'degraded' badge. Asked for clear token names for the badge color states. Provided performance constraints for animation durations (max 120ms when busy).

2026-03-06 - QA (Tom Becker): Ran initial QA on prototype. Found three edge cases: 1) truncated sparkline tooltips in compact mode, 2) cost drilldown table header sticky behavior inconsistent across browsers, 3) keyboard focus order skips rollout badge when a banner is present. Added to QA findings.

2026-03-08 - Marco Liu: Addressed Tom's findings in Figma: adjusted tooltip truncation, updated table header spec, documented keyboard focus order. Uploaded developer handoff doc and PRD links. Requested engineering estimate on implementation complexity.
2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Preparing for design review with stakeholders. Seeking final sign-off from PM Sara Thompson and Eng lead Priya before moving status to 'Planned' for sprints.
acceptance_criteria: Figma redlines and motion specs uploaded and linked in attachments
Developer handoff doc includes exact token names and values for colors, spacing, and typography
All QA findings marked resolved or tracked with ENG tickets
Accessibility pass: cost sparklines meet AA contrast and keyboard focus order validated
PM sign-off captured in comments and release tag set to console-2026.03
qa_findings: Tooltip truncation in compact mode (fixed in Figma, verify in implementation)
Sticky header drift on Safari for cost drilldown (investigate CSS position strategy)
Keyboard focus order skips rollout badge when global banner is present (ensure badge is in DOM order before banner or implement focus management)
Microinteraction timings must be capped at 120ms under load per ENG guidance
dev_notes: Rollout state transitions: idle -> deploying -> degraded -> unavailable -> rolled-back. See motion spec for easing and durations.
Compact mode: tile density reduces left/right padding by 8px and hides secondary metadata; ensure tooltip anchors reposition correctly.
Accessibility: provide aria-labels for rollout badges and a skiplink to the cost drilldown table for screen readers.
ux_decisions: Use passive badge (dot + label) for degraded state and a full-width banner for unavailable capacity to reduce false alarms.
Increase contrast of cost sparkline color to #0B5FFF on light backgrounds for AA compliance against the tile background.
Compact mode prioritizes density; secondary microcopy collapses into hover or accessible tooltip rather than inline text.
Prefer implicit animation (opacity + translateY) capped at 120ms for status transitions to avoid perceived jank under load.
next_steps: Design review presentation on 2026-03-11 with PM, Eng leads, and Design leadership
Create ENG-XXXX implementation tickets for each unresolved QA finding (owner: Priya Nair)
After eng estimates, schedule canary implementation in Sprint 2026.03 and pair with exploratory QA
Post-launch: monitor Console metrics for rollback rate and cost tile render errors for two weeks
